title: World Graph Studio Connection adapter manifest
description: Strict portable authoring profile for entries returned through worldgraph_conn_adapters. It intentionally requires explicit labels and normalized object shapes even where the PHP runtime accepts older compatibility forms. Runtime closures must be represented by a function/class string or a [class, method] array before validation.

callable.description: A portable PHP callable: function/class string or [class, method]. Closures are valid only in the runtime PHP manifest and cannot be serialized here.

test.description: Callable (int connection_id, array record): array|WP_Error. The record is Connection_Repository::get() output, not the decoded resolve() shape. The returned array contains success, message, and health; core persists the normalized result.

after_save.description: Optional synchronous callable (int connection_id, array record): void. Keep it lightweight and schedule slow work.

render_admin.description: Optional trusted wp-admin callable (WP_Post connection_post, array adapter): void. It must escape output and protect mutations with capabilities and nonces.

provision.description: Callable (int connection_id): array|WP_Error. It idempotently creates or updates provider Templates.

status_meta_prefix.description: Stable non-secret prefix for <prefix>_synced_at and <prefix>_error Connection metadata.

client.description: Loaded class name implementing the static generation client signatures.

client_resolver.description: Callable (array connection, string provider_template_id, string adapter): string returning a trusted loaded client class.

poll.description: Whether a successful submission may require asynchronous polling.

poll_with_template.description: Whether get_job_status receives provider_template_id as its third argument.

adapter.description: Fixed sanitized adapter marker or callable (array connection, string provider_template_id, string adapter): string.

media_inputs.description: Whether this adapter supports authorized resolved media inputs.

flatten_inputs.description: Merge resolved media inputs into top-level parameters instead of parameters.inputs.

poll_error_limit.description: Consecutive polling WP_Error results allowed before terminal failure.

permanent_error_codes.description: Stable provider-prefixed WP_Error codes that make a polling error immediately terminal.

loader.description: Callable (string provider_type, array adapter): void. External plugins use it to load their own implementation files.

init.description: Optional callable (): void invoked once after the adapter implementation loads.
